title: anathema
summary: Something or someone that one vehemently dislikes; a formal curse by a pope or a council of the Church, excommunicating a person or denouncing a doctrine.
whyItMatters: The word spans both everyday dislike and the formal language of ecclesiastical condemnation, which gives it unusual range and force.
notes: In modern usage it is often used figuratively, but the older religious meaning still gives it extra weight and severity.
